name: React Aria · ComboBox

title.zh: React Aria · 采用行为与状态能力后

description.zh: ComboBox 输入及列表框组合 React Aria 提供带交互行为、状态和国际化支持的 React 组件，并把视觉样式留给使用者定义。入门页连接安装、组件范围和不同样式方式；ComboBox 示例完整显示输入与展开按钮、单选多选配置及 JSX 用法。可沿组成部分与状态接口接入自己的设计系统，当前证据展示默认示例，不代表已执行键盘或无障碍测试。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by React Aria (https://react-aria.adobe.com/).
Technology stack: react, typescript, css.
Component specification: ComboBox 输入及列表框组合


Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
